title: Entire Nashville Home mins from Downtown & Opry
description:
Wake up refreshed in this established, quiet neighborhood, ready to enjoy everything Nashville has to offer. Brew a cup of coffee using the fully equipped kitchen and relax on the back patio as you plan your day. This peaceful home, a short drive from downtown Nashville, features vaulted ceilings, artistic décor, and polished hardwood floors. A comfortable workspace complete with a desk, comfortable chair, and charging station is available for our savvy business guests.

The space
This spacious home is only 10 miles from the sprawling landscape of Downtown Nashville  and 7 miles from the original Grand Ole Opry where your favorite country stars got their frame.  Shop and enjoy many of the restaurants at Opry Mills.

Guest access
The whole entire house is for you and your family to enjoy.  Plenty of space in the backyard for outdoor fun.

Other things to note
Yes, we do allow dog(s).  There's a $99 pet fee per dog.
